bullets.text: Anbumani Ramadoss warned that constructing a boundary wall in the Pallikaranai wetland in Chennai would cause disaster, and the office should monitor public grievances.
Residents in Chennai and Thiruvallur protested and faced severe hardships due to continuous day and night power cuts, requiring the office to track utility outages.
A car suddenly caught fire on the road near Velachery in Chennai, causing panic, and police are investigating the incident.
The state highways department desilted three culverts along Jawaharlal Nehru Salai near the Velachery MRTS station in Chennai to flood-proof the area ahead of the monsoon.
The Madras High Court heard a case against the National Green Tribunal ban on construction within a one-kilometer radius of the Pallikaranai wetland in Chennai.
TANGEDCO announced a five-hour power shutdown for maintenance affecting areas like Ambattur, Tambaram, and Avadi in Chennai and Thiruvallur.
Residents in Poonamallee faced distress due to frequent night-time power outages, and the office should monitor local electricity supplies.
MGNREGA workers angered by low wages staged a protest by besieging the BDO office in Thiruttani, Thiruvallur.
Tamil Nadu is procuring power from private suppliers to ease increasing electricity shortages, and the office should monitor energy management strategies.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to swiftly grant early approval for the Chennai Metro Rail Phase-III project.
Tamil Nadu is witnessing a turnaround in its Global Capability Centre wave with expanding existing operations and new company setups across sectors.
Youth Congress members staged a black balloon protest in Chennai as Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Vijay inaugurated the Poonamallee-Vadapalani metro rail service.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss warned TVK against repeating mistakes made by the DMK, while addressing wetland issues.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay is scheduled to visit Andhra Pradesh to meet Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu regarding Krishna river water sharing.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi laid foundation stones and launched development projects worth over Rs 13,000 crore spanning multiple sectors in Chennai.
Chief Minister Vijay requested Prime Minister Narendra Modi to reconsider the metro rail projects for Madurai and Coimbatore during an event at IIT Madras.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi pledged continued support from the Centre to accelerate development in Tamil Nadu during his visit.
